Maya P: Putting the PRD draft into the channel for a short triage — need quick alignment on: prioritization across chat/completions vs embeddings vs rerank, acceptance gating criteria, and the fallback/routing policy shape. Link: <https://drive.redwood/prd-routing-draft|PRD draft> :eyes:

Devin K: skimmed the doc. main questions: 1) do we treat rerank as sync or async by default? 2) cost cap per API call — do we set a hard cap or a sliding alert threshold?

Maya P: good Q. proposal in doc is: rerank default = sync for top-k <= 20, async for larger jobs. cost cap = alert threshold at 2x expected unit cost + optional hard reject on enterprise flag. open to pushback.

Samir R: edge cases to call out — context window overflow for chat that triggers embeddings/rerank fallback should be explicit. i.e., when input tokens > model window, do we: trim, chunk+async, or fail? customer asks prefer chunking with a best-effort merge.

Ella C: compatibility note — existing SDKs expect stable response shapes. if we add an async rerank path we need a compatibility shim in the API (status endpoint + webhook option). Acceptance criteria should include SDK parity and no-major-contract-change for GA.

Devin K: tiny nit on SLOs — we propose 95th p50/95 latency targets per endpoint in PRD. can we add budgeted token cost for the combined path (chat + rerank + embeddings) so customers can estimate worst-case pricing?

Maya P: yes — added a "budgeted worst-case" section. also added explicit rollout gates: canary with 5% traffic, synthetic load tests for prefix-caching, and regression checks on existing eval sets.

Samir R: suggest adding an "staleness tolerance" acceptance criteria for cached KV prefixes: max_ttl default 60s, with customer-configurable override. saves tokens but avoids stale completions.

Ella C: For edge cases, add these tests to acceptance checklist: 
- long prompt truncation behavior documented
- embedding drift detection (monthly)
- fallback chain correctness when a model returns malformed logits

Maya P: added those to the checklists. Also logged outstanding decisions: 
1) whether to surface a cost-estimate header in-hosted responses (yes/no)
2) exact default for rerank sync threshold (20 vs 50)
3) hard reject option semantics for cost cap

ops-bot: Canary deploy scheduled for 2026-04-12 18:00 UTC (job id dpl-9042). Automated smoke tests: pending.

Devin K: I'll take ownership of the rollback/fallback playbook doc. will post a short runbook update by EOD Thursday. :thumbsup:

Maya P: thanks team — please leave short comments in the doc rather than long threads. aim to lock acceptance criteria by Friday so engineering can scope the first sprint.

Samir R: Ack. adding a short list of unit/integration tests to the doc now.

Ella C: ACK.

Maya P: closing loop — next sync if needed after reviews are in. thanks! :sparkles:
